A '''Proximity flare''' was a type of early warning system.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Characteristics==
Used by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] as early warning systems for camp perimeters, a proximity flare was a flare launcher consisting of a small tube with a spike on the bottom, allowing it to be securely placed in the ground. [[Sensor/Legends|Sensors]] inside the tube could detect nearby shifts in air-pressure; when an object of sufficient size passed within ten meters of the launcher, it would fire the flare into the air and illuminate the area.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
